prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1453; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while turning left in Pasadena, Texas. Are you comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently live.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but I can confirm I live in Pasadena.

Q: That's acceptable. Can you describe what you were doing right before the collision?

A: I was driving through an intersection and wanted to turn left into a shopping center. The light had turned yellow, and I waited for oncoming traffic to clear before I started the turn.

Q: How fast were you moving when you began the turn?

A: I was going slowly, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I'd almost stopped at the middle of the intersection.

Q: What happened next?

A: A car coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my vehicle. I didn't see it coming until right before impact. I braked, but there wasn't time.

Q: Did you notice whether the other driver had a signal on?

A: I don't think so. I didn't see a turn signal, but I wasn't paying attention to that at the time.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My left wrist hit the door frame and the steering wheel. I was taken to the hospital and they said it was fractured. I've been wearing a splint and I'm following up with an orthopedic doctor.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble with my wrist and I'm worried about missing work.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
